questions.body_en: Three strings of balloons are arranged as follows: String 1: balloons 1, 4, 7 (top to bottom); String 2: balloons 2, 5, 8, 9 (top to bottom); String 3: balloons 3, 6 (top to bottom). Each balloon is popped subject to: it must not knock down other balloons (so only the topmost of each string may be popped), and consecutive pops must be from different strings. How many ways can balloon 6 be popped in the 5th position?
